svg.text: Belt barrier relay: real-trial rig, from task.py (mm; table top z = 0)
1. Plan view from above. x forward from the arm bases, y to the robot's left. Robot at the bottom, wall at the top.
wall board 1220 x 610 x 18 plywood, standing on the table
dashed arcs: about 600 reach from each base
arm bases 610 apart, centred on y = 0
2. Front elevation, looking at the wall from the robot (the robot's left on the left). Heights above the table top.
3. The 898 wall clip seen from the robot (left; its slot opens toward the unit, on the right) and a plan section across its slot (right), 4x scale.
end fitting front (belt pull up the page)
bead 6 x 3.5, neck 2.5 thick; 1 mm chamfers on the lips' top edges
4. Belt end, side view from the robot (its front, with the end fitting, on the left as in view 2; the belt on the right), 4x scale.
All numbers come from task.py, except the arm bases and reach (Robocurve station). est. = estimate, no published figure.
Clip outline, screw spacing: Tensabarrier 898 drawing. Slot, lips and end fitting: estimates; measure the real clip and end. Belt pull 8.9 N toward the unit's mouth. No latch.
